question: Can you help me find the top 5 countries whose players have the highest average of their individual average runs per match across all seasons? Specifically, for each player, calculate their average runs per match over all matches they played, then compute the average of these player averages for each country, and include these country batting averages in the result.
sql:
WITH player_runs_per_match AS (
    SELECT 
        b.match_id,
        b.striker as player_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) as runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND b.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
        AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE b.striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.striker
),
player_match_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        prpm.player_id,
        prpm.match_id,
        SUM(prpm.runs) as total_runs_in_match
    FROM player_runs_per_match prpm
    GROUP BY prpm.player_id, prpm.match_id
),
player_avg_runs_per_match AS (
    SELECT 
        pmr.player_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pmr.match_id) as matches_played,
        AVG(pmr.total_runs_in_match) as avg_runs_per_match
    FROM player_match_runs pmr
    GROUP BY pmr.player_id
),
country_player_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        p.country_name,
        AVG(pamr.avg_runs_per_match) as avg_of_player_avgs
    FROM player_avg_runs_per_match pamr
    JOIN player p ON pamr.player_id = p.player_id
    GROUP BY p.country_name
)
SELECT 
    country_name,
    ROUND(avg_of_player_avgs, 4) as avg_runs_per_match
FROM country_player_avg 
ORDER BY avg_of_player_avgs DESC
LIMIT 5
